updates.производительность: Results prose: a 45 mN von Frey mechanical filament evoked rolling in 92% of wild-type larvae (n=36) versus 13% of painless1 mutants (n=31); the mechanical percentages are not assigned to Figure 2E. Figure 2E concerns heat-probe responses. Figure 3C-E reports temperature-linked peripheral nerve firing in wild type and its absence in painless mutants.
